title: Account Credit Set Against Site-Change Estimates — Imaging and Procedure Authorizations
content:
The credit offset in the site-change estimate for an Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization or an Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization moved to another site (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) follows the balance of the patient's Patient Financial Account, the amount due being the relieved copay and deductible part plus the missed-visit deposit:

- a credit at least as large as the amount due offsets the whole amount due;
- a smaller credit offsets its own amount;
- an account without a credit offsets nothing.

The estimate signed for is the amount due less the credit offset. An account carries a credit when its balance is below zero; the credit is the amount by which the balance is below zero.

## Worked cases (hypothetical amount due of 60.00)

| Account balance | Credit | Credit offset | Amount due less the offset |
|---|---|---|---|
| minus 80.00 | 80.00 | 60.00 — the whole amount due | 0.00 |
| minus 60.00 | 60.00 | 60.00 — the credit equals the amount due | 0.00 |
| minus 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 — its own amount | 35.00 |
| 0.00 | none | nothing | 60.00 |
| 120.00 owed | none | nothing | 60.00 |
